profiles.label: Jungle hunter archetype

requiredAnchors.label: Light asymmetric armor
requiredAnchors.requirement: Sparse plates protect shoulder, chest, groin and shins over mesh while retaining high mobility and an original arrangement.

requiredAnchors.label: Single shoulder caster
requiredAnchors.requirement: One compact shoulder energy caster aligns with a back-mounted articulated aiming arm.

promptDirectives: Invent mask engravings, trophy arrangement, pose and jungle camera while retaining a light hunter loadout.

profiles.label: Urban city hunter archetype

requiredAnchors.label: Angular urban biomask
requiredAnchors.requirement: A narrow angular mask and compact sensor layout suit close urban pursuit without copying an official prop.

requiredAnchors.label: Expanded close-hunt tools
requiredAnchors.requirement: Disc, telescoping spear or net system mounts coherently beside gauntlets and a single caster.

promptDirectives: Use a new urban perch, mask pattern and functional tool arrangement.

profiles.label: Scar ritual hunter archetype

requiredAnchors.label: Visible ritual scar
requiredAnchors.requirement: A deliberate healed ritual mark on face or armor communicates earned status without reproducing a protected glyph exactly.

requiredAnchors.label: Young champion build
requiredAnchors.requirement: Broad athletic mass, ceremonial armor and confident stance distinguish a capable initiate from elder and super-hunter forms.

promptDirectives: Invent ritual mark geometry and armor engraving around the champion archetype.

profiles.label: Celtic heavy initiate archetype

requiredAnchors.label: Broad heavy biomask
requiredAnchors.requirement: A wide heavy biomask, reinforced brow and large cheek planes create a battering silhouette without duplicating the screen prop.

requiredAnchors.label: Heavy initiate armor
requiredAnchors.requirement: Heavier chest, shoulder and forearm plates suit close combat while retaining asymmetric mobility and mesh underlayer.

promptDirectives: Design original heavy mask geometry and plate edges around the close-combat role.

profiles.label: Chopper blade specialist archetype

requiredAnchors.label: Extended wrist-blade system
requiredAnchors.requirement: Exceptionally long parallel wrist blades extend from a credible gauntlet and clear hand and forearm through motion.

requiredAnchors.label: Trophy-forward silhouette
requiredAnchors.requirement: Original trophies and tall mask accents identify a ritual blade specialist without blocking head movement.

promptDirectives: Prove wrist-blade mechanics and invent every trophy and mask detail.

profiles.label: Wolf veteran cleaner archetype

requiredAnchors.label: Veteran facial and armor damage
requiredAnchors.requirement: Asymmetric healed facial damage and repaired armor show long service without reproducing a performer face.

requiredAnchors.label: Dual shoulder-caster rig
requiredAnchors.requirement: Two compact shoulder weapons articulate independently from a balanced back harness without collision.

requiredAnchors.label: Containment and cleanup tools
requiredAnchors.requirement: Specialized tools and sealed vessels mount as a disciplined response kit rather than trophy clutter.

promptDirectives: Create a new veteran face, repairs and containment kit while retaining dual-caster logic.

profiles.label: Berserker super-hunter archetype

requiredAnchors.label: Extreme upper-body mass
requiredAnchors.requirement: A taller denser subspecies silhouette carries enlarged neck, shoulders and forearms while remaining agile and anatomically yautja.

requiredAnchors.label: Elongated aggressive mandibles
requiredAnchors.requirement: Underlying head volume supports longer rougher four-part mandibles distinct from the standard hunter.

requiredAnchors.label: Brutal functional mask
requiredAnchors.requirement: A heavy original mask communicates dominance through form without copying an identifiable jaw-shaped prop.

promptDirectives: Preserve four-mandible head logic beneath an original brutal mask and massive frame.

profiles.label: Falconer reconnaissance hunter

requiredAnchors.label: Lean reconnaissance frame
requiredAnchors.requirement: Lighter armor and a lean long-limbed build distinguish a mobile observer from the berserker leader.

requiredAnchors.label: Aerial drone interface
requiredAnchors.requirement: An original compact aerial scout and its controller or docking system share visible design and communication logic.

promptDirectives: Design a new scout-drone silhouette and believable control link.

profiles.label: Tracker beast-master hunter

requiredAnchors.label: Beast-master loadout
requiredAnchors.requirement: Tracking controls, release hardware and scent or telemetry tools mount coherently to armor.

requiredAnchors.label: Controlled hunting-hound relationship
requiredAnchors.requirement: When shown, gesture, spacing or attention establishes command without merging hunter and hound silhouettes.

promptDirectives: Pair with yautja.hound as a secondary profile whenever the beast is visible.

profiles.label: Feral frontier hunter archetype

requiredAnchors.label: Lean primitive-adapted frame
requiredAnchors.requirement: A leaner long-limbed build and narrower head volume remain distinctly yautja rather than human.

requiredAnchors.label: Open bone-like hunting mask
requiredAnchors.requirement: An original pale skeletal mask protects the upper face while accommodating mandibles and avoiding an exact prop silhouette.

requiredAnchors.label: Compact frontier technology
requiredAnchors.requirement: Bolt, shield or gauntlet systems combine advanced mechanisms with rugged hand-finished materials.

promptDirectives: Invent mask apertures and compact weapons around lean frontier-hunter anatomy.

profiles.label: Ahab elder trophy-hunter archetype

requiredAnchors.label: Elder age and asymmetric loss
requiredAnchors.requirement: Pale aged skin, quill wear, scars and a damaged or missing eye establish an old survivor without matching a published panel or face.

requiredAnchors.label: Archival trophy kit
requiredAnchors.requirement: Ancient repaired armor, specimen tools and a few meaningful trophies read as a lifetime record rather than clutter.

promptDirectives: Author a new elder face, scars, trophies and pose from written traits only.

profiles.label: Yaquita legless veteran hunter

requiredAnchors.label: Unambiguously legless silhouette
requiredAnchors.requirement: Both legs are anatomically absent below a coherent scarred and armored pelvic termination; framing must prove the absence rather than hide ordinary legs outside the crop.

requiredAnchors.label: Upper-body compensation
requiredAnchors.requirement: Powerful shoulders, long arms, reinforced hands and balanced torso mass plausibly support a veteran who continues to hunt without lower limbs.

requiredAnchors.label: Adaptive hunt mobility
requiredAnchors.requirement: The scene shows one coherent original mobility solution—arm-driven climbing, low support harness or braced firing position—without inventing normal legs or a generic wheelchair.

requiredAnchors.label: Veteran repairs and healed loss
requiredAnchors.requirement: Healed tissue, repaired armor and redistributed equipment make the old loss functional and deliberate rather than a fresh gore effect.

promptDirectives: Show the complete legless body boundary and a plausible original hunting posture while retaining full yautja species anatomy.
